integrity: The maximal geodesics are classified directly: every length-two path with same-part endpoints is maximal, while a cross-part edge is maximal exactly when both endpoint parts are singletons. A transversal is therefore exactly a set whose complement contains none of these maximal geodesics. This gives the two complement families, from which the minimum, enumerator, and basis count follow by exact counting. The standalone verifier independently constructs maximal geodesics and tests every subset through order ten.
scientific_limitations: The scalar geodesic-transversal number is related to the published general theorem for graph joins and can be recovered from prior theory by specialization.
The new content is the complete all-set classification, cardinality enumerator, and minimum-set classification for arbitrary complete multipartite part profiles.
Geodesic packing and k-geodesic-transversal variants are not treated.
Finite exhaustive verification through order ten is corroborative only.
A differently phrased or non-indexed all-set treatment may exist despite targeted searches.
title: All geodesic transversals of complete multipartite graphs
